normalization: Address remapping through retained original-VA labels/linker map; RIP addresses resolved from llvm-objdump comments and matched to IAT/state/name symbols; JE=JZ and JNE=JNZ; whitespace/case ignored; original registers/widths/immediates/branch destinations retained.
limitations: Static wrapper equivalence only; compiler-generated C++ DllMain was not proven instruction-equivalent.
PE layout, section RVAs, function addresses, exception/unwind metadata, and binary bytes can differ.
Embedded component remains original machine code, not recovered C++ source.
Original and rebuilt DLLs were never loaded or executed; full runtime equivalence remains untested.
